sections.title: Letter name vé
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (vé) /veː/. Its main sound is heard in (víz) /ˈviːz/, which means water. This letter makes only one sound in Hungarian.

sections.title: How to say vé
paragraphs: Place your top teeth lightly on your lower lip. Push air through the small gap with your voice turned on. A voiced sound is a sound where the voice is on. Touch your throat with your hand, and you can feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading vé in words
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound heard in (víz) /ˈviːz/. It sounds the same in every standard position. You also hear it in the word (tavasz) /ˈtɒvɒs/.

sections.title: Avoiding common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not round your lips like the w sound in water. Always touch your bottom lip with your top teeth, as in English vine. Also, keep your voice turned on, so it does not turn into an f sound.
